segments.name: Banking Division
segments.description: Provides full service financial services, including commercial and consumer lending and deposit accounts, to retail and commercial customers.
segments.evidence: The Banking Division derives its revenues from the delivery of full service financial services to include commercial loans, consumer loans and deposit accounts.

segments.name: Retail Mortgage Division
segments.description: Originates, sells and services one-to-four family residential mortgage loans.
segments.evidence: The Retail Mortgage Division derives its revenues from the origination, sales and servicing of one-to-four family residential mortgage loans.

segments.name: Warehouse Lending Division
segments.description: Originates and services warehouse lines of credit to other businesses secured by residential mortgage loans and servicing rights.
segments.evidence: The Warehouse Lending Division derives its revenues from the origination and servicing of warehouse lines to other businesses that are secured by underlying one-to-four family residential mortgage loans and residential mortgage servicing rights.

segments.name: Premium Finance Division
segments.description: Originates and services commercial insurance premium finance loans for borrowers throughout the United States.
segments.evidence: The Premium Finance Division derives its revenues from the origination and servicing of commercial insurance premium finance loans.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from interest and fees on loans to business and consumer borrowers, loan sales and servicing, and deposit services.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company evaluates performance and allocates resources based on profit or loss from operations.
